source: Triodian project note 'United States - jurisdiction scope (US.1)' and the Atlas US round (data/research/2026-11-14-us-overlay.json in obligations-atlas). The inputs name the documents a US entity in the sector usually holds; whether an instrument applies is counsel's question, and the matter brief lists the records.

packs.name: Bank (United States)
packs.instruments: SR 26-2 on model risk, the 2023 interagency third-party guidance and, in New York, 23 NYCRR 500

I5: Register of third-party relationships, with those that support critical activities marked, and their subcontractors
Third-party relationship register, critical activities marked
I7: AI governance framework, permitted-use policy, AI inventory and the model inventory with each model's validation status
AI governance framework, AI inventory and model inventory

packs.name: Insurer (United States)
packs.instruments: the NAIC model bulletin on AI systems as each state has issued it and, in New York, Insurance Circular Letter No. 7

I5: Register of third-party AI systems and data vendors, with their audit and cooperation terms
Third-party AI systems and data vendor register
I7: Written AI systems programme, permitted-use policy and AI inventory, with the states in which the insurer writes business that have issued the model bulletin
Written AI systems programme and AI inventory

packs.name: Broker-dealer or investment adviser (United States)
packs.instruments: Regulation S-P, FINRA Rule 3110 and FINRA's 2026 report on generative AI and AI agents

I7: AI governance framework, AI inventory, and the written supervisory procedures that cover generative AI and AI agents
AI inventory and written supervisory procedures
I10: Incident response programme and customer notification procedure, with each service provider's notice terms
Incident response programme and notice terms

packs.name: Health care provider (United States)
packs.instruments: 45 CFR 92.210 on patient care decision support tools, the HIPAA business associate terms and the HTI-5 changes to certified health IT

I5: Register of business associates and other providers, with each agreement
I7: AI governance framework, AI inventory, and the inventory of patient care decision support tools with the record of how discrimination risk in each was reduced
AI inventory and decision support tool inventory

packs.consequencePrompt: Does a single patient whose care is delayed or denied because of AI count as harm, or only a pattern of them?

packs.name: Critical infrastructure owner or operator (United States)
packs.instruments: NERC CIP-013 supply chain risk management (bulk electric system) and CIRCIA incident and ransom-payment reporting once its final rule is in force

I5: Vendor register and the supply chain cyber security risk management plan
Vendor register and supply chain plan
I10: Incident notification procedure, with the reporting timings that will apply once the CIRCIA rule is in force
Incident notification procedure, ready for CIRCIA

packs.consequencePrompt: Does a single unplanned change to an operational setting count as harm even when service is not disrupted, or only one that disrupts it?
